description: Appends a second drifted group and makes checkedAt unparseable, so GroupLinkStatus renders the plural arms of its stale.length ternaries in src/components/GroupLinkStatus/index.js and takes formatDate's Number.isNaN guard in src/components/shared/formatDate.js. The ordinary coverage overlay appends exactly one archived group, so that build renders the singular grammar and the verification line; both arms are only reachable in one Playwright run because the variant build is served beside the real one. The appended group drifts through reachable:false rather than archived:true so the filter's second operand decides it, as a link-check run that cannot reach the repository produces.
